groups.activity: Break Narmer weekly mission (solo, as Kahl)

rows.label: Stock
rows.alt: blue Stock crates, 2 each, 5 per run, respawn on replay

conditions: The Garrison ranks once per completed weekly mission; replaying can't speed up reaching Rank 4.
Finishing the mission alone gives zero Stock; weekly Stock comes from the bonus challenges (up to 105) and blue Stock crates.
The weekly mission only rotates after you complete it, so skipping a week leaves the same one waiting.
Picked-up Stock is lost if you die or abort; beat the boss and extract to keep it.
bonuses: The 15-minute challenge completes when the final boss dies; backtrack for missed collectibles before extracting.
Kahl's loot radar shows genestamps, caches and Stock crates.
In Sneaky Sabotage, sprint past Deacons; flashbangs work on them.

disclosures.title: Stock is shared across all of Chipper's stock
disclosures.body: Styanax parts, Afentis, Slaytra, Archon mods and the rest draw from the same Stock pool; the wiki prices the full non-rotating shop at 980 Stock. Spend early weeks on lower-rank items and keep 30 for the week you hit Rank 4.

disclosures.title: point-of-no-return areas
disclosures.body: Some Break Narmer maps lock you out of collectibles you missed earlier. Which maps still have them isn't documented, so clear side rooms before the boss or extraction area.
